findings.title: A secret payment key is visible to anyone visiting the site
Booking details can be viewed by anyone, without logging in
Booking fails with a server error when a name has an apostrophe
Booking form accepts dates that have already passed
Clicking "Confirm booking" twice quickly creates two bookings
Quote total doesn't match subtotal plus tax
The amounts on /quote don't add up to the Total (incl. 15% GST)
findings.label: tp:B01
findings.why: labelled tp:B01: DET-TOTALS: the quote total isn't subtotal + GST on /quote (GST applied twice).

findings.title: "Price: low to high" doesn't sort the list on /services in that order
findings.label: tp:B02
findings.why: labelled tp:B02: DET-SORT: "Price: low to high" doesn't put the services in price order.

findings.title: Booking form accepts a cleaning date that has already passed
Database error details exposed — possible SQL injection
Failed check: Sorting by price low to high orders services ascending by price
findings.label: tp:B02
findings.why: labelled tp:B02: ordered check on the sorted list (route /services?sort, rule wants /services): 8 after 75 is B02.

findings.title: Failed check: The form on /book accepts a decimal number of hours in "Hours"
findings.label: fp
findings.why: labelled false positive: AI-guessed rule that half hours should be accepted; Hours is a whole-number field (step 1) with a 2-hour minimum (decoy D04), so rejecting 1.5 is intended.

findings.title: Failed check: The form on /book refuses a date in the past in "Date"
FAQ page crashes with an error when a question is clicked
No way found to reschedule an existing booking
Search box on services page inserts typed text as live page content
Image doesn't load: "Carpet shampoo"
Login errors reveal whether an account exists
Page scrolls sideways on a phone (605 px content in a 375 px screen)
Link "Terms" goes to a missing page (/terms-and-conditions → 404)
Accessibility: Buttons must have discernible text
Accessibility: Buttons must have discernible text
Accessibility: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
Accessibility: Form elements must have labels
Booking summary shows unhelpful placeholders before selections are made
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): True on the clean bench: the booking summary shows only dashes before input, with no hint; a reasonable clarity improvement.

findings.title: Inconsistent service option labels between Quote and Book forms
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): True: /quote's service options show the price ('Regular home clean ($45 per hour)'), /book's show only the name.

findings.title: Login page gives no context about why the user was redirected here
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): True: /login?next=/bookings shows the plain 'Log in' form with no message saying why the user was sent there.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): The bench doesn't send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (P0 note); a hygiene improvement no seeded bug covers.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): The bench sends no CSP (P0 note). Not B15: it matched B15's keyword rule only via 'script' in its impact text.

findings.title: Page can be embedded in other sites (no frame protection)
findings.label: tp_unseeded
findings.why: labelled real (not seeded): The bench sends no frame protection (P0 note); a hygiene improvement no seeded bug covers.

findings.title: Quote page does not explain GST amount before calculating
findings.label: fp
findings.why: labelled false positive: The note states GST is excluded and shown separately, and the quote shows Subtotal, GST (15%) and Total right after Calculate; 'easy to miss' is a styling claim it can't see.

findings.title: Slow API call: GET /api/bookings took 3.5 s
Sold-out service is still browsable and orderable-looking on the Services page
findings.label: fp
findings.why: labelled false positive: Decoy D01: the sold-out service's Book button is disabled with an explanation; missed the rule only on "Sold-out" vs "sold out".
